assertions.assertion: The service is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The arrhythmias or ischemic changes may be contributing to the symptomatic episodes
